description: LTDS Appendix 4 - Transformer Data is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our LTDS Appendix 4 dataset details data relating to the transformers found at Northern Powergrid's primary substations and supply points. The data includes naming conventions, primary and secondary nameplate voltages, R/X/B impedance values, and tap changer information e.g. connections and tapping ranges. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Long Term Development Statement (LTDS), Transformer, Extra High Voltage (EHV), EHV Substation Data. The portal shows 2025-11-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
